title: Update on Implementation of Recommendations by National Wellness Committee for Junior Doctors
what_it_is: Update on Implementation of Recommendations by National Wellness Committee for Junior Doctors

sections.label: Junior doctor wellness progress
sections.summary: MOH reports progress on National Wellness Committee recommendations, with healthcare clusters appointing Chief Wellness Officers and around 100 doctors enrolled in or appointed to the HC scheme.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Since our last update in Parliament in May 2024, the Ministry of Health (MOH) has made progress in implementing the recommendations of the National Wellness Committee for Junior Doctors.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Each of our healthcare clusters has appointed Chief Wellness Officers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Currently, around 100 doctors have either enrolled in or been appointed to the HC scheme.

sections.label: HC scheme and work hours
sections.summary: The HC scheme has been refined since 2020, and close to half of clinical departments with junior doctors have implemented shift rosters or 24-hour limits.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Since its introduction in 2020, we have refined the scheme to enable junior doctors to join earlier in their careers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Doctors now also have the flexibility to switch into the HC career pathway from other medical career tracks.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: In collaboration with our healthcare clusters, MOH has implemented pilots aimed at improving the work hours of our junior doctors.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: To date, close to half of all clinical departments with junior doctors have implemented shift rosters or have limited their doctors to working no more than 24 hours continuously.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: This practice will be extended to more departments progressively as we expand our medical workforce.
